work.projectDescription:
>Do the Uncomfortable Frequently, Fearlessly
Media page about helping people step outside their comfort zone (website)

(Phone App) - Main premise
"Mini game" giving users small tasks that urge them to step out of their comfortability
work.gitEvidence: As we got more familiar with the engine we started to move 3d objects around our little "game" by implementing code with Microsoft Visual Studios
work.aiVerify: Running game and just simply playing it
work.notes: I think I am well versed in the use of AI with how I can use it as either a team member or tool

requirements.title: Working project foundation
requirements.evidence: Working source and build (60); authored program logic (35); meaningful tests (20); run guide and evidence map (20); individual explanation (15).

requirements.title: Save and restore progress
requirements.evidence: Save meaningful state; close and reopen the program; demonstrate correct restoration and invalid-file handling.

requirements.title: Modular architecture
requirements.evidence: Show a module/class diagram, clear responsibilities and a change made without rewriting unrelated systems.

requirements.title: Architecture defense and maintenance guide
requirements.evidence: Individually explain unfamiliar code sections, trace data flow and make a small requested change.

requirements.title: Secure input and data handling
requirements.evidence: Document threats relevant to the project and test validation, safe error handling and protection of private data.

requirements.title: External playtest and revision
requirements.evidence: Use consented feedback from at least three testers; document problems, fixes and retest evidence.

team.name: DUFF - Do the Unknown Frequently , Fearlessly
